configurePresets.name: ninja
configurePresets.description: Use Ninja generator for maximum parallel build throughput (default recommended).

configurePresets.name: mingw
configurePresets.description: Keep the historical MinGW Makefiles workflow (non-parallel; use -- -j N).

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Equivalent to CI's `emcmake cmake` invocation: Emscripten toolchain via %EMSDK% (set by `emsdk activate --permanent`), WASM backend on, tests on (run them with `ctest --test-dir build-wasm`), demos on-demand.

configurePresets.name: ninja-shards
configurePresets.description: Same as `ninja`, but splits the test runner into 4 shards (AURORA_TEST_SHARDS=4) so the test link step parallelises instead of serialising all cases into one executable. AURORA_TEST_SHARDS stays 1 by default: this preset is the explicit activation path, and other counts are swept on top of it with -DAURORA_TEST_SHARDS=<N>.

configurePresets.name: measure
configurePresets.description: Fixed conditions for a before/after compile-speed comparison: dedicated build-measure/ directory, gcc, Release, ccache disabled. Vary only the knob under test on top of it (e.g. -DAURORA_TEST_SHARDS=4 or -DAURORA_ENABLE_UNITY_CORE=ON) so both sides share the directory, the compiler and the cache setting.

testPresets.name: ninja-test
testPresets.description: Run the full ctest suite in build/ with per-test process isolation in parallel (equivalent to ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -j N).

testPresets.name: ninja-shards-test
testPresets.description: Run the ctest suite in build-shards/ (the 4-way sharded test runner preset). Same per-test process isolation and parallelism as ninja-test; only the runner split differs.
